services.name: Guided Snorkel Tour
services.desc: Join our semi-private guided snorkel tours and explore the stunning marine life of Shaw’s Cove! Meet at the beach where your expert guide will lead you through Southern California’s beautiful kelp forests. Enjoy 45 minutes in the water as our guide introduces you to the beauty of Southern California’s kelp forests and their marine life. All gear provided-just bring your sense of adventure! Recommended for ages six and up. All guests must be able to swim in the ocean. Guests must secure their own transportation to Shaw’s Cove. blurb: The Ocean Institute offers interactive exhibits and hands-on experiences about Southern California’s marine life and maritime heritage. Visitors can join whale and marine life cruises, tall ship sails, and other programs on weekends. The campus is open to the public on Saturdays and Sundays from 10 am to 3 pm.
